mintAuthority.summary: yzUSD issuance requires USDT0 transfers from the caller before calculated shares are minted. MINTER_ROLE is receiver eligibility, not an arbitrary token-mint privilege: the earlier block 33896709 census of 101 eligible accounts (97 no-code, four contracts) does not establish 101 independent unbacked issuance paths. The current V3 implementation and collateral-funded path were reverified at Plasma block 33932322. Upgrades remain behind the reviewed 48-hour timelock and limit/restriction parameters behind the reviewed 12-hour timelock; stored NAV remains privileged internal pricing. Fordefi manages protocol collateral operations, not investor eligibility keys.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14/A7 review on 2026-10-03 at plasma block 34111101 (0x76ec454a35b7d9034b400e7684654382a2a27820b8b26c8c5be241468aadc2e3): the proxy still resolves to verified YuzuUSDV3 0x8e02392855a51d9d5d18d71a7cfc731f56c68ea5. YuzuUSDV3.mint/deposit call YuzuIssuer._deposit, which transfers USDT0 from the caller to the buffer/treasury before __yuzu_mint. MINTER_ROLE determines receiver eligibility; setSupplyCap and throttle/restriction administration expand admitted deposit capacity but do not bypass that transfer. Stored NAV affects share pricing and remains an oracle/valuation surface, not a new collateral-free mint privilege. Upgrade authority alone is not D14. Retain raiseable with raiseable-collateral-only proof and correct curated posture to partially-bounded-admin, the compiler-derived posture for the reviewed raiseable cap; no D29 certificate is authored. A current MINTER_ROLE receiver 0xc72f80402c060d6fb89359f319d1daa20166f282 was re-read and its one-yzUSD mint simulation reverted ERC20: transfer amount exceeds allowance.
